releaseGateHandOver.finding: the platform names a materialised candidate snapshot REVIEW_REQUIRED and its gates measure staged rows and a source-row count; the first load wrote PREPARED, no staged rows and an observation count, so the existing gate endpoint refused it (400)
releaseGateHandOver.conformance: the load now writes the platform's candidate state, one staged row per source row (VALID or REJECTED with its findings) and the source-row count; nothing in the gate service was special-cased for statistical contracts
releaseGateHandOver.gateMadeToConform: STATISTICAL_SEMANTICS_VALID counted every empty value as a defect; an empty value with a declared status (missing, suppressed, not applicable) is now a fact of its own and only an unexplained empty value fails the gate (register Q22)
releaseGateHandOver.notDone: publication of the proof snapshot: a proof dataset must not be published; publication stays a steward decision

defectsFoundLive: object key prefix without the trailing slash required by the artifact key convention (400) - fixed, test double now applies the real key rules

a revised measure version in a new contract revision collided with the metric code of the previous version (DuplicateKey, 400) - metric identity is now dataset x exact measure version; covered by revisedMeasureVersionInANewContractRevisionBindsItsOwnMetric
candidate snapshot state and staged rows did not match what the existing release gates measure - conformed, see releaseGateHandOver
